## Activity

During April 2025, North City Eye Clinic completed 584 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as part of the clinic’s routine imaging service. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and no other operational issues were noted in the monthly report. The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures set out below.

## Image quality

Graders assessed the image sets produced during the month and marked 9 as ungradable. This represented an ungradable rate of 1.5 per cent of captures. The result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable cases should continue to be reviewed through routine quality assurance, with feedback provided where this may support image capture practice.

## Grading

Grading identified 156 referable results. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 1 day. These results describe the service recorded for April 2025 and should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality measures. The clinic should continue routine monitoring of grading timeliness and referable findings through its established operational processes.
